definitions.gloss: to carry around, to take with oneself
definitions.explanation: To carry something while moving from place to place.

examples.japanese: いつもスマホを{持|も}ち{歩|ある}いている。
examples.english: I always carry my smartphone with me.

examples.japanese: {傘|かさ}を{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く{習慣|しゅうかん}がある。
examples.english: I have a habit of carrying an umbrella around.

examples.japanese: {現金|げんきん}をたくさん{持|も}ち{歩|ある}くのは{危険|きけん}だ。
examples.english: It's dangerous to carry a lot of cash around.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}{旅行|りょこう}ではパスポートをいつも{持|も}ち{歩|ある}くようにしている。
examples.english: When traveling abroad, I make sure to always carry my passport with me.

notes:
{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く means to carry something around with you as you go about your daily activities.

COMPOUND VERB:
Formed from {持|も}つ (to hold) + {歩|ある}く (to walk). The combination emphasizes carrying something habitually or while moving from place to place.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: スマホを{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く

ASPECT (ている):
{持|も}ち{歩|ある}いている indicates a habitual practice of carrying something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- いつも{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く: to always carry around
- {現金|げんきん}を{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く: to carry cash
- {傘|かさ}を{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く: to carry an umbrella
- パスポートを{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く: to carry a passport

RELATED: {携帯|けいたい}する is a more formal synonym meaning "to carry/bring along."
